tokens.name: ks-ink
tokens.usage: Primary ink: all text on paper, white and the pastel stages; every 3px outline and every hard shadow; the dark band. 16.2:1 on ks-paper, 6:1 on ks-flame, 16:1 on ks-lime.

tokens.name: ks-paper
tokens.usage: Cream page ground, agent cards and paper buttons; also body text on ks-ink (16.2:1).

tokens.name: ks-white
tokens.usage: Pricing plans, approval-queue panel, stage tags and queue buttons. Text on it is ks-ink.

tokens.name: ks-flame
tokens.usage: Hero and closing bands (the flame rings' light arc). Ground only: ks-ink text on it (6:1). Never text on paper (2.7:1).

tokens.name: ks-flame-deep
tokens.usage: Dark arc of the flame rings (--c2 in .ks-hero-rings). Pattern only.

tokens.name: ks-flame-hot
tokens.usage: Hard shadow under the featured (ink) pricing plan and its lime button.

tokens.name: ks-lime
tokens.usage: Marquee and 'zero' bands, the lime button, active filter pill, the hard shadow under cream cards, highlight text on ink (16:1) and on ks-ink-raised (14.6:1).

tokens.name: ks-lime-deep
tokens.usage: Dark arc of the lime rings (.ks-mq-rings). Pattern only.

tokens.name: ks-focus
tokens.usage: 3px focus outline on every link and button. 3.35:1 on paper, 4.8:1 on ink, 3.3:1 on lime; FAILS on ks-flame (1.24:1): the source keeps it, so on flame bands rely on the 4px offset putting the ring over the ink outline and test it.

tokens.name: ks-text-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary body copy and card skills lines on ks-paper (10.5:1) and white.

tokens.name: ks-text-muted
tokens.usage: Metadata (price units, queue row meta) on ks-paper (6.5:1) and white (7.5:1).

tokens.name: ks-text-card
tokens.usage: Agent-card description text on ks-paper (13:1).

tokens.name: ks-on-ink-soft
tokens.usage: Soft lilac body copy and stat labels on ks-ink (11.4:1) and ks-ink-raised (10.4:1).

tokens.name: ks-on-ink-muted
tokens.usage: Muted units on ks-ink, such as the featured plan's 'per caseworker / month' (9:1).

tokens.name: ks-on-ink-faint
tokens.usage: The '/mo' unit inside the ink price pill (14.2:1 on ks-ink).

tokens.name: ks-ink-raised
tokens.usage: Raised surface on ink: rule cards.

tokens.name: ks-ink-line
tokens.usage: 2px border of rule cards on ks-ink-raised. Decorative edge, not a control border.

tokens.name: ks-ink-ring
tokens.usage: Second arc of the ink rings (.ks-ink-rings). Pattern only.

tokens.name: ks-flame-shadow
tokens.usage: Second arc of the ring pattern clipped into stencil type (.ks-wave-text), paired with ks-ink.

styles.name: type-display-xl
